cars.generation: 1994–1996 B-body Impala SS rear-drive performance-saloon generation

cars.generation: Original CX-series SVX production-road grand-touring coupe family
cars.specification_market: Original Subaru US brochure MSA8M9201/3118-280, full publicly offered scan archive and actual specification spread 18 visually read. Its unusual engineering and lasting design identity make it a Japanese GT icon rather than an ordinary luxury derivative.
